description: Sixteen voltage sources in four groups, each group with its own level, its own pair of offsets and a VCA over all four of its outputs, and a master level and offset over every group

params.text: Sets the level of that group's four outputs, multiplied by the voltage at the group's CV jack when one is patched
Maps that group's CV from -5V to 5V across the whole of the group level, instead of taking the voltage as it comes
Shifts every output of that group down, by 0-10V, before the group level
Shifts every output of that group up, by 0-10V, before the group level
Sets the voltage of that output within its group, -5V to 5V before the group's offsets and levels
Sets the level of all sixteen outputs, multiplied by the voltage at the master CV jack when one is patched
Shifts all sixteen outputs up, by 0-10V, before the master level
Shifts all sixteen outputs down, by 0-10V, before the master level

inputs.text: Multiplies that group's level by the voltage here
Multiplies the master level by the voltage here

outputs.text: The voltage of that knob, offset and scaled by its group and then by the master

notes: the master level and all four group levels start at zero, and every output is multiplied by both, so nothing reaches any output until the master and the group being used are raised
